confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are the most reliable: three crowd-sourced sources (Whereandwhen, Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere) broadly agree. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced; they are set from a local beer multiple (about 3x and 2.2x) and are low confidence. Hostel and hotel anchors are the weakest: the listing and aggregator figures are in mixed currencies, undated or inconsistent, and not July-specific, so they are bounded judgements. Online prices are a proxy for what guests pay, and Cairo prices vary by neighbourhood and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Cairo's own price points from the sources, with Egypt's large EGP/USD move treated as a source of uncertainty. Hostel dorm and private rates were cross-checked against Egypt-wide and Cairo listing averages; hotel rates were cross-checked against EUR-quoted aggregator 3-star averages.
